description: Twelve floors, clad to the ninth, crane down, and from Kerbstone Row it is three storeys off being a building. It is also the only shell in the quarter where the hoarding is blank — plain chrome board, no printing, no crest and no date. That was a decision made after the third completion date slipped, and it has done more for the estate's reputation than any of the printed ones ever did.
name: Scope for Improvement
